r198037.n: Buy cheap, sell high... I traveled many roads along Umoir. Few people…

r198090.n: Do you have something for me?

r198091.n: Oh, it’s you again! Well? Have you found the treasure? Yes... Go three…

r198097.n: Do you have something for me?

t: And again the trenches of Metalville, the whistle of shrapnel, and the rumble of artillery... Stand fast! We will not retreat from these ruins. The attack of the Reds will be repulsed!
r198098.n: And again the trenches of Metalville, the whistle of shrapnel, and the…

t: Just another blind kitten, whose eyes are about to open. Boy, do I like what I'm beginning to see! Our old names will mean nothing soon, you'll see.
It was... wonderful! Forgetting everything and starting afresh! This time we can make it. Right?

Oh, Darkness? Darkness is good. It hides everything I don't want to see. Darkness is the new order of things. The undisturbed, quiet world, ready for the new dawn, for the change. Ready for new beginnings.

It's very near. And it's far away... Ah...
r198348.n: The Darkness fills your mind. Fight it!

t:
Why am I here? I'm just a harbinger. The Dark condescended to you. It's the greatest honor.

What am I heralding? Ugh, the ability to listen has never been your forte. The message has been delivered. Now it's just a matter of time.

I remember... I remember a dream, which is a rare thing.

The dream about the future. About what's going to happen later, on another Earth, under a different sky. The grandchildren of our grandchildren are going to live in the light of Darkness. Our names and our deeds will be gradually erased from history.
r198350.n: You're talking nonsense. What's the meaning of all this?

t:
Ah, don't you worry, your help is valuable the way it is. You're on of the protagonist! The main character of the Show!

The monumental character, both tragic and comic, like the fate itself.

It's all right. The amazing new world will welcome everyone.

It's weird, though. All roads lead back to you, through all the wondrous places and mysterious times.
r198352.n: Move along. You are not welcome here.

t:
I'm only a guardsman. Who might want to save someone like me? No one is going to save us. It's all a big joke.
When I was a child, I dreamt of becoming a general, but they told me only children of generals would be allowed to reach that rank. So I ended up becoming a cannoneer. Boom! Hah! I even have a marksmanship badge. Do you want to see it? Hm, where is it? It's gone! Did you steal it?
They'll come after you eventually! Who? They... They'll be here soon. The Empire will be finished, and I'll be a general. That's how it's going to be!

This is humiliating! A delicate woman like me in the arms of Imperial dogs! I remember how I used to dream of being captured. They would chain me up, undress me... It seemed so exciting! But this isn't like that at all. It's cold and the food is awful.
But I know that the League Army won't leave me here. My family will make them do something! ...At least that priest was kind to me. Oh Ignat, you are so wonderful!
r198489.n: This is humiliating! A delicate woman like me in the arms of Imperial…

t: That can't be! Really? Is this some kind of joke?
Oh Tensess, I'm sick of prison food.
r198494.n: Oh Tensess, I'm sick of prison food.

t: Oh, finally. Your Xadaganian hospitality is making me sick.
The rescue mission is clearly being delayed.
r198501.n: The rescue mission is clearly being delayed.

t: Whaaat? I'm not going anywhere until I have my butterfly collection! I've been gathering it for over a century!
The truce, you say? Alright then, although it's hard to believe. Don't touch me! I'll walk.
r198509.n: I have an order signed by Yasker. The Empire and the League have reached the truce.

t: Nice try, I don't believe you. We know better than that.
r198510.n: All elves are granted an amnesty. You're free, you can leave Igsh now.

t: I wonder what's got into the tyrant and dictator. I'll go, alright. But don't touch me, or I'll scratch out your eyes.
r198514.n: Here's the order signed by Yasker. All elves are being transported from Igsh over 24…

t: You're only trying to lure us outside.
r198515.n: All elves are granted an amnesty. You're free, you can leave Igsh now.

t: I can tell you're lying... ah, whatever. I'm sick of being here anyway.
r198520.n: Yasker sent me over to supervise your release and transportation from Igsh.

t: Nice try! I'm not buying it.
r198521.n: All elves are granted an amnesty. You're free, you can leave Igsh now.

t: Aaaaa! I need help! Not the mines again!
r198522.n: Aaaaa! I need help! Not the mines again!

t: Boohoo. I'm sick of being here. Can I switch jobs?
r198531.n: Boohoo. I'm sick of being here. Can I switch jobs?

t:
This makes things much easier.

Who do we have here... let's see... Ardeur, Blizare, Vevre, Grandeur... Yep, those are our inmates. We have a problem with Desirae, Delice, and Pluie. They escaped. If I could have it my way, I'd send them to community service forever. I can't count the times we caught them. And now what? We have to release them? Of our own accord?

Come on, we have no choice. This is a mission of national importance! I'll get the paperwork moving and the portal set up. We'll transport the prisoners from Igsh.

You won't have to look for the inmates. We know exactly where they are.
r198534.n: Deliver the Elf Amnesty Order to the prison warden.

t: Greetings, friend! The prison is in perfect condition, the number of jailbreaks isn't any higher than in the recent years. I already sent an explanatory note about the incident with the elven girl.
r198535.n: Greetings, friend! The prison is in perfect condition, the number of…

t:
I will now enter a trance and peer into your future...
Your destiny lies to the south, in Igsh Military District. You will participate in many battles there.
Wow! I see three faces. They're all very high-ranking people! Elizaveta Rysina, Wrokag the Northwind, and Negus Kheket. They all want to see you, and each will give you an important mission.
Hm. I also see someone else. It's a strange man who appears to avoid the company of Imperial citizens. What could this mean...
Ah, I see! He's an upstart of some sort. It's important that you meet him or you'll miss some important events.
One last thing - be sure to mind your superiors and help them out when you can. Now go seek out your destiny!
r198551.n: I will now enter a trance and peer into your future... Your destiny…

t:
Let's see what I can find out today... It appears the time has come for you to visit the ZIT Headquarters. You're lucky for it really is a beautiful place. I would have liked to stay there myself if it weren't for that quarrelsome Nomarkh Imhotep. But I digress...
Let's get back to your future. I see that something is amiss at the ZIT. You'll have to help the scientists out in many ways. It appears that even the main pyramid itself is having problems.
One last thing - you should be sure to talk with a Xadaganian man. Unfortunately, the vision isn't very clear and I can't tell you why. Just make sure you heed this advice!
r198552.n: Ask for a prediction of the fourteenth level

t:
Alright, I'll peer into your future straight away! Now let me concentrate...
The first person I see is Elizaveta Rysina. You should make sure to see her before you set off for your next destination - the Dead Sea!
You should also go see Wrokag. He has an important mission for you that could affect all Orcs.
This thread of fate seems to lead into the darkness, and I can't tell if it's broken or not.
Finally, I see an Arisen along the northern shore and an Orc in a deep dark place. They will play a big role in your destiny. It's essential that you find them!
r198553.n: Ask for a prediction of the sixteenth level

t: How can anyone lose such thing as a goblin head? Alright, here's another.

Ah, your future is very easy to see right now. You need to visit two Orcs! The first is Wrokag, the Supreme Chief of the Orcs, and the second is Crazystorm of the Imperial Sentinels.
Both of them have an important mission for you, but they have very different motives. You should make sure to carry out both. The outcomes will be important to the entire Empire!
r198857.n: Ask for a prediction of the nineteenth level

t:
At this time I don't even need to enter a trance. I was told that Negus Kheket, Elizaveta Rysina, Wrokag, Crazystorm, and Yasker himself want to see you!
I'm not sure what's wrong, but it must be something very serious because they turned to me for a prediction. Your name was the one that appeared to me as a potential Imperial hero.
Go to Yasker's Tower and see what they need. They might find it hard to trust you at first. If they are not immediately convinced of your loyalty, then perhaps there are some tasks you need to complete first. Go and unravel this mystery!
r198888.n: At this time I don't even need to enter a trance. I was told that…

t:
I will now enter a deep trance and predict your destiny! Hm, your thread of fate looks very, very thin. In fact, it seems to be broken in multiple places. It appears you will soon visit the Holy Land and fight many difficult battles.
Unfortunately, there seems to be no other option for you. You must enter the thick of war. The Imperial General Kirill Sechin, the City Council agent Vlada Merinova, and the Imperial Colonel Braid the Bloodthirsty all need your help.
Make sure you also visit Yasker before your journey. He shall give you some information that you need to know before you brave the jungle.
r198889.n: I will now enter a deep trance and predict your destiny! Hm, your…

t:
I can see your thread of fate leading into the darkness of Tensess Temple. There you shall find many obstacles, including some strange magical barrier. Hm... I don't know if this is one obstacle you'll be able to overcome yet, but I sense that this is a mission you should start...
In any case, go and visit Anatoly Aldanov, the Imperial diplomat in Asee-Teph. He's going to play an important role in your destiny - that I know for sure. It will be a minor role, but one that is essential.
r198890.n: Ask for a prediction of the twenty-sixth level

t: The June history is an example set for us.
r198905.n: The June history is an example set for us.

r198919.n: Offer to escort them to camp

t: That's good news, we're eager to get going!
r198939.n: Offer to escort them to camp

t: Excellent! We finally made it to the Holy Land!
r198940.n: Excellent! We finally made it to the Holy Land!

t: I'd normally say no, but you're a great hero! Here is our tribe's mask.
r199007.n: May I participate in the ritual?

t:
We begged the Junes for forgiveness!

And they spared our lives. They switched to a war with dragons...

By that time, our folk has split. Those who could talk with trees became Forestfold. Those who speak with the river became Waterfolk, and Mountainfolk were the people of mountains.

June helped us like no one helped us before. And there was the day when they needed our help!

Their people split as well. Some of them remained the June people and came to this village, which has been on this river bank for thousands of years. Rumor has it, it was warmer before.

But their Curse was awake! It followed them. A June gave his life to protect his own kin and my tribe. We saved our lives while he was standing guard.

We've been worshipping the hero ever since. Sometimes his spirit pays a visit.

The pipe... Where did you get it? It's a secret!

Alright, I'll tell you, although we don't tell out secrets to strangers.

There's a legend that is passed from generation to generation.

A powerful race once lived here. You call this race the Junes.

Forestfolk were just a part of a large nation that united Waterfolk and Mountainfolk. We were proud and numerous. We occupied all land and wanted more. So we engaged in warfare with Junes!

Of course, they were much stronger. In the end, we lost. We couldn't count the victims, and the Junes chased us down to the edge of the land. We ran and scattered across the world...
r199009.n: Do you know what this reed pipe is for?

t: You see the ripples, realizing that it was the demon who caused them! Now you have to defeat the Fiend from the Depth.
r199013.n: Pour Lizardman Blood onto the brazier.

t: The brazier is lit, time to start the ceremony.
r199014.n: The brazier is lit, time to start the ceremony.

t:
Let me peer into the future... Hm. Frankly, I have never seen such a tangled thread. It seems that you should go to Eljune, the eastern part of the Holy Land. There you will need to complete many tasks. You might want to write this down.
First of all, you need to visit Anatoly Aldanov again. He'll give you some instructions that I can't seem to make out. Just know that you should follow them.
Secondly, make sure to visit the forestfolk of Eljune. Their land is being invaded by lizardmen, and it appears that the identity of their leader will reveal many mysteries.
Third, visit Georgi Batalov. He's a famed Imperial commander and he will give you many, many assignments that will help the Empire out.
Let's see, what else... It seems you will need to aid the Historians as well. It appears that the facts you will uncover will remain important to you well into the future.
Finally, I see you helping many disciples of the Light. You need to see Irina Lazareva and the Great Ascetic Zosim Nikulin. Zosim is a Kanian, but he will not be your enemy. Make sure you take his words to heart.
r199023.n: Ask for a prediction of the twenty-seventh level

t:
I am now entering a deep trance... Hm, do you remember an Arisen by the name of Nomarkh Userkaf? It appears he will have an important mission for you! Remember where you met him and visit him right away.
From there you will go to Coba Plateau in the western part of the Holy Land. It seems you will have to associate with many who are not part of the League or the Empire. I see Historians, Prospectors, and even Demon Hunters. It is through them that you will discover where your fate leads.
r199024.n: Ask for a prediction of the thirty-first level

t:
So, you need my services once again? Very well. Let me enter a trance... Hm, it appears that you are destined to go to a very cold place. In fact, it's an allod named Coldberg. Perhaps you've already heard of this land - I feel that you may have already gotten orders to go there from some very important people.
Once you get to Coldberg you will meet with an important Orc. It appears that they have already entered your life sometime in the past, but I cannot say when. The threads are very tangled. I hope you can make sense of this puzzle and fulfill your destiny.
r199026.n: Ask for a prediction of the thirty-fifth level

t:
Your thread of fate is covered with your blood. And blood of thousands of creatures, all slain by the hand of the Unknown.
The Empire is counting on your loyalty!
It all clears up now. Visit Elizaveta Rysina once again. She will send you to vanquish some great monster in Avilon, but I sense you will come through this trial just fine.
These lines brings you to an Elven Historian while you're there. They seem to look like ancient June drawings.
What a mystery! You will have the chance to solve something that exciting.
r199027.n: Ask for a prediction of the thirty-sixth level

t:
Let me look into the future once again. I see... I see... wow, a dragon! It's a huge and majestic beast! I believe you are meant to meet with this amazing creature.
I also see an Orc. Her name is Koga the Crafty and she seems to be quite a fighter. However, she seems to have a small problem that she can't solve on her own. Unfortunately I don't have anything else to tell you. The rest you must solve by yourself.
r199028.n: Ask for a prediction of the thirty-seventh level

t:
I will now enter a deep trance and gather my powers... Oh, I see Yasker! He is... he is performing some amazing feat of strength. Wow, I never imagined he had such power. I suppose he is a Great Mage. Hm.
You should definitely listen to anything Yasker says, but that should go without saying. He is our leader after all! He shall send you to Yazes Shard where you will be tested many times.
I also sense that your missions will be of national importance. Make sure you keep your eyes open at all times. Any details could be important!
r199029.n: Ask for a prediction of the thirty-eighth level

t:
Alright, let me call upon my powers. Hm... If you and I weren't well acquainted right now I would probably call for a detachment of Yasker Hawks to arrest you. I can see that your thread will become interwoven with many demon-worshipping cultists.
I'm putting a lot of trust in you right now. I assume that there's a very good reason for this association. Actually, the more I look the more it becomes apparent that it will help the entire Empire - perhaps the entire world!
There is one more reason that I did not call the Hawks. It appears that Yasker himself will point you in this direction. I suggest you visit him and find out what it all means.
r199030.n: Alright, let me call upon my powers. Hm... If you and I weren't well…

t:
I don't need to use my powers to tell you what to do next. You need to see Yasker immediately! I was told to inform you about an important mission concerning Gorluxor's Tower.
It's a very dangerous place - more dangerous than anywhere you've been before. This is probably why I see your thread intertwined with many others. It seems you'll need to gather a small battalion to defeat the monsters inside.
I also see this tower lying in ruins one day... I believe that it's you who will help this come to pass. Now go and see that this vision is fulfilled!
r199230.n: Ask for a prediction of the fortieth level

t:
Wait a minute, let me tune in to a mystical wave.
After Director was defeated, a veil of darkness fell from my eyes, and now I can make new predictions again. Well, well... Very unusual.
I see... death! You are lying in a metal coffin, and your body is cold and motionless...
I see two clouds rising above the horizon, carried by the wind and torn apart... All this happens again and again.
And I see what's behind the scenery, a Puppeteer who pulls the strings making everyone dance to his tunes. Could it be Director himself, returned from nonbeing?
I do not know. It may not be a lucky prediction, but this is the truth.
Take care!
r199274.n: Ask for a prediction of the fifty-first level

t: Hurry up, we don't have much time.
Can't you just walk there?.. Oh, alright...
Can't you just walk there?.. Oh, alright...

I outsmarted myself. I studied Skrakan's archives in search for the source of power. He described a strange event in Gorluxor's Tower, when a strong demon appeared out of nowhere... Just imagine all the energy! Unbelievable magic and supreme technologies! I could bring the world back to peace, take it under full control and power...

Only it wasn't just another random demon. It was one of the first children of Sarn, his own Avatar, created during the times of June Curse. While I thought I was bringing him under my control, it was seizing my consciousness. This is why I happen to help the Leper spread...

The Leper is just another side of creation. This is life, made of the very same primal matter. The only difference is that it's able to corrupt other forms of life. Sarn has gone mad. His gift of the Creator now serves the evil and makes his wicked fantasies come true.

While my mind was under control, I was able to touch his consciousness, but never dared. I was scared by an ocean of madness and malice...

It's unimaginable! Just one little shard of Sarn's soul, encased in the avatar he created himself - what a huge power it turned out to conceal! He could have done so much with this power, but he preferred his pathetic attempts to break free... You know, I think I nearly pity him. Hm, it's not typical for me.

This is the Seal. If you could only sense all the primal, natural magic here! It's under our feet, and all around us! If you could only understand, how tempting it is... but I do not dare touching it. I've learned my lesson. Nihaz, who created the Seals, was a way stronger and craftier than Sarn. Oh, even if the God of Light strived to conform to him, we can only guess, what the God of Darkness was apt to perform...

We'd better leave this place. It's not good for mortal beings.

I am going to return to Skytower and make it right. My allod is my prison now, just like the Seals are prison to Sarn. I'm not mad, though, and I'm not going to try and break my prison!

I will have to make peace between the pagans and the followers of the Light. I must admit, outcasts acted their best at this war... Besides, if it weren't for them, you would have never reached this place. Establishing peace won't be easy. I will have to engage all diplomacy I can, and at the same time, to make sure that neither Empire nor League have their fingers in my pie! My play is too artful to let them into it. The Leper - a common enemy - will unite us... and they don't need to know that it's so weak now, that it's no danger at all for neither of the sides.

What next? Only time can tell. This union might help Umoir prosper... As to you, you certainly deserve my gratitude. Thank you for showing me many unexpected things. Believe me, it's not so easy, given all my experience.

Go now. Leave me. I have to give it all a deep thought...

This is a curious story. Their sparks first met at Tep's Pyramid. Now they meet in person.

I guess you are the cause of this meeting. You have been able to make the Astral do, what you need. You needed allies, and they came to the rescue. Your will, plus Sarn's power, plus their own conscience - and there you go.

You don't have to worry about the consequences. As soon as you leave this place, they will disappear. Simple, like that.
Don't chat too much. We don't have time.
You're more stubborn than I'd thought.
r199317.n: You're more stubborn than I'd thought.

t:
Would you like me to lift the veil of time to see into the future? Concentrate and look me in the eye.

There's a thicket on this allod. Dark shadow crawling along, turning everything upside down, inside out... There's you fighting this shadow, this disease, so that it wouldn't spread.

I can see a ship, a huge one, I've never seen a ship so big before. Two women on the deck, one ginger-haired, the other raven-haired, both of them deceitful, both meaning to abuse you. Will it lead you to the good or to the bad?.. This, I do not know.

Many astral islands are on your path, and the path is long and winding...

There's more! Ancient Gods, born before the Light! They don't have much power now, but their help will tip the scale. And there are young Gods hard on their heels...

This is all I can see in your future. I hope it helps. Good bye.

You need a prediction again? Alright, let me concentrate...

Oh my! Dead as it is, my skin crawls at this sight. You are going to one cold place, all made of snow and ice. But you are not going to stay there for long. Then... I see strange things. As if your were going to the past... The further you go, the stranger it gets. It's all dark and grey around you with glimpses of blue light... This path leads you further than anyone has been before. Maybe even outside the Astral...

Also, you are going to meet a great power. I cannot define its intentions. It is neither good nor evil. It wants something, but I cannot see what it is. One thing I can tell for sure is that if we let it get what it wants, our lives will never be the same.

Need a professional prediction? Well, you came to the right place. Just a minute, I need to tune in...

Your adventure will start with a mad messenger. I can sense her presence - she's in Nezebgrad already. You will go to the place where she came from and see the reason of her madness for yourself.

I can see an allod where you've never been before. Green forests, mountains, fields. There stands... a fortress? And a big city. But now everything is on fire... Dead bodies everywhere. The smell of death and decomposition follows you wherever you go. You hear moans and cries, but louder than anything - the clanking of metal. You will witness a tragedy...

There is. No. War.

A strange alliance is waiting for you, and far more strange enemies, too. I've seen them already... They have no emotions, no soul. Full oblivion. Their power is beyond gods... It brings death not to us, but to our world order.

This is all I can see. The future is dark, and your way is a narrow path. Step carefully.
r199402.n: Need a professional prediction? Well, you came to the right place.…

t:
Ah, you again. Your fate is much more intriguing than that of my regular clients. Shall we start?

I can see your path leading you to lands that never existed before. You will be the first one in this world to step on a new allod and meet people whom no one has ever met... They are remarkable people, and they wield great power. Their lands are young and beautiful, and each grass blade on it is full of exuberant vitality. The heart of that allod is a pillar of pure light; a site of tremendous power.

But I can see darkness crawling up to that allod... And another darkness which is corroding it from the inside.

Be careful. Not everything in those lands is as beautiful as it seems.

Hello, hello. I knew you'd come. I have a prediction ready for you, didn't even have to attune myself. You're quite a regular.

Here it is.

Fate will take you to an allod with a bloody history so ancient that no one remembers it anymore. I see crimson roses and cliffs of ashes. Your allies have found shelter here, and you will respond to their call.

But your help will cost you dearly. This allod is like a chessboard for the Light and Darkness, and you are a pawn on it. Whether you die or promote on it, I can't say.

Yes, it's not a happy prediction, but that can't be helped. I'm not one to embellish reality...

Greetings.

My prediction is really simple this time. Skulnar the Fierce will contact you. I can't tell you the reason.
But there's one thing I do know. You and I will meet again.

I'm leaving Nezebgrad. I'm going to the Holy Land. Something troubles me. I need to check something.

You need to find Skulnar the Fierce. As far as I know, he's on Coldberg now.

I'm glad to see you again.

As you know, the latest news is not good.

I'm afraid we're dealing with the God of Darkness again. Fortunately, the darkness has dissipated a little.

Now, the predictions. Dominus Cosmos will be looking for you. Answer his call. Then... I see a ship. Looks like an Imperial one. It's far away... But you will find it. And with it, new challenges.

Then... You will return to Umoir. Meet some of your old acquaintances. I see armies of the dead... I can't see which side they are on.

Finally... The Citadel. Something unthinkable awaits you there. I'm sorry, that's all I can see right now.

Hmm. Calculating! Analyzing. Entering a trance state...

Wait until political battles start in Sarnaut. The Great Ball is starting soon.

You will attend it. Yasker will charge you with an important mission.

But I sense a threat. I see blurry shadows. Hmm, interesting. Beware of the harlequin! Beware of the viper lady!

I sense the Empire will be victorious. But there's another threat in the future!

Something terrible. Something threatening the very foundation of the Empire! Be careful!

I wanted to meet you myself. My ability to peer into the future has weakened! Someone is interfering with the timeline, and it's not the Observatory.

I suspect someone will contact you soon, so I'll tell you my personal prediction. The situation with the temporal anomalies has gotten out of hand. The leadership sanctioned the creation of a temporal stabilizer that will protect us against irresponsible time travelers!

You will be summoned to Suslanger. Once we worked there in the Copper Mines.

Today, it's a beautiful place. You can rest there like I used to before. New adventures await you there. This is what I saw:

Your decisions will affect the fate of the world. So choose wisely. Remember: trust must be earned. Beware of the Storm, because that Storm can carry away a camel. Beware of summer nights, because sometimes it's difficult to say the words you must say. And the most important thing: beware of the glint of gold, of grey cloaks and hidden blades!
r199408.n: I wanted to meet you myself. My ability to peer into the future has…

t:
Greetings. Ready for prediction. Entering a trance state... Seeing the future.

I see an imperial object. I believe this is Gates-3, so you are destined to visit Suslanger again. Now I see some fragments... Allods? Doesn't look like it. Now I see... something incomprehensible. The moon? Covered by seas and vegetation? Strange.

Could this be another world?

I guess you're going to visit it.

I see trees. A lot of trees. I sense danger. But also opportunities. Opportunities to learn more.

Then... The road forks. I believe you will have to make a choice that will determine your fate. At the end of the path, I see a figure. A dark figure that obscures the sky. Strange.

I don't know how it's going to end.

Greetings. Entering a trance is not required. Acquired the necessary information through neural messaging. Read at your leisure:

I see it so clearly:

The tree is dying,

The ancient enemy has been awakened,

There is no rest for the dead!

Deadly Frost will come,

And countless enemies

Whose skin is white.

I see it through time.

Blood ties get stronger:

Pilgrim's children

Will take ragged weaving

And tie it into a whole.

It is difficult to assess both the source of the information and what it refers to. I believe, however, that future events connected to you will have something to do with this... prediction. As far as the dead are concerned, we can already see the consequences. However, everything is done at the behest of our new authorities.

r199413.n: Получить предсказание для стопятнадцатого уровня развития

t:
Hello there!
Do you need a prediction? Since my services are paid for by the government, you'll be able to learn about your future without paying a single copper! If you're confused about your life path or what you should be doing, I can send you in the right direction immediately!
What level prediction do you need?

Nezebgrad's magic field has changed a lot lately, and not in a good way.

Not only strong mages and prophets faced the consequences. Average citizens sensed it, too. The public paranoia started. People experience insomnia and depression.

On top of that, psychologically disturbed individuals appeared in town. They foretell the future and spell doom, and the problem is, the may be right.
Great, now we can rest easy!
r199418.n: Yes! All ghosts have been found!

t: Keep looking! They are around here somewhere!
r199419.n: I can't find the ghost named Artem Furazhkin

t: Hey, you! Yes, you! Come here! Are you looking for batteries for your armor? Or maybe you need memory modules?
Whatever you say. What is it?
r199676.n: I'd like to talk about something else.

t:
I'm sure you've heard of it. The Tycoon Club consists of seven richest merchants. In these challenging times my employers are looking for ways to divert people's attention from the main trouble and get some profit. I see nothing wrong here! What can be more profitable than heavy betting on bloody skirmishes? I was tasked with finding brave and strong people to participate in the skirmishes. We'll say our grace! Who knows, you might succeed! Are you willing to take a chance?
I'll be happy if you decide to join us. You will receive payment in Tycoon Collector's Coins, which you can spend on rare items or donate to our special fund to increase your reputation. We will monitor your progress. Fight! It is up to you whether you make it a success or a failure.
r199677.n: Tell me about the Tycoon club's purpose

t: My employers are planning to invest in this new booming entertainment. You surely attracted attention! The Tycoon Club believes in your potential, and therefore, they're going to help you. To help you shine, we are ready to give you access to our especially rare goods, which you can't find in a regular Boutique.
r199678.n: Tell me about the Tycoon club's ambitions

t: The Tycoon Club is pleased with the way things are going. The Gladiator skirmishes are gaining popularity. People are craving new bloodier shows. My employer might consider raising funds. You are getting more and more famous, and the public wants to see you. You just can't stop now! Go on, prove yourself! We are going to support you. Enjoy access to the special goods that will help you in battle.
r199679.n: Tell me about the Tycoon club's actions

t: Rumor has it, the Tycoons are mobbed up... well, that's true. Alas, it's the only way to get the rarest goods. We're offering them to you as a gesture of good faith. Admittedly, we were right to place our bets on you! You proved to be a truly great and mighty warrior, deserving the eternal glory on the battlefield. Of course, you've got both friends and foes, but they all admit that you're the best in battle. They'll be happy to witness your skill in the coming battles!
r199680.n: Tell me about the Tycoon club's secrets

t:
Have you ever heard about the Training Camp? You know, the green spot full of golems. You should know it. It's a mysterious place. The Zem heritage. You see, they lost most of their secrets after death, and they're trying to recover them. They're ahead of us, and it makes me sad. But I'm sure it won't be long now! By the order of Queen Catherina we recruited the wisest and most educated men to dismantle the Zem wonders piece by piece and figure out how they work. If the Empire can do it, so can we! But we need help. Your help. We won't leave your favor unpaid! We'll share all our findings. So, what do you say?

Are you willing to help? You will receive payment in Training Camp Explorer tokens, which you can spend on different things we find there or donate to increase your reputation. Don't abandon us! The League, our Motherland, needs your help!
r199729.n: Tell me about the Training Camp explorers

t: The Zem had very tricky machinery. Very hard to handle. But don't worry, our researchers have discovered a thing or two. They're dismantling the gears and hinges. I can sell you the things they're done studying.
r199730.n: Tell me about the initial research results

t: Thank you for your help, friend! The more we study the complex devices, the more scary they get. The Zem did awful things. All their machinery was meant to pull the life force from the living beings. Ugh, what a dirty trick! The Training Camp was the facility where they studied feeding the life energy to the dead things. There's nothing left to do but keep up the research. As for you, you have our gratitude and a couple of curious things.
r199731.n: Tell me about the extensive research results

t: What can I say? We worked out everything. Although I don't think it's for the best. You're one of us now, so you should be prepared for the truth! Here we go. The Training Camp was a facility where they studied leeching life from the living things and redirecting it to the dead. All golems and other clockwork monsters were inactive for many years - until people came and started killing one another. The blood was spilled. It gave new energy to the golems. You know what, I think you should keep it secret. People are uncomfortable enough already. I'll describe it as it is for Catherina, though. Perhaps, she'll find a way to fix things. As for you, I expect your silence in exchange to access to all our findings.
r199732.n: Tell me about the final research results

t:
We are Sculptor's disciples. Don't be alarmed, we're not as mad as the goblin. Our mission is simple. Do you want to know what it is? I'm keeping the cards face down just yet. Let's negotiate a business deal. Do you know the Tower of Order? Go there and fight. We're paying well.
If you agree, listen up. You'll earn Sculptor's shards, which you can spend on goods or donate for reputation. It's a tough call, but it's part of the deal. Perhaps, the most important deal in your life. Are you interested now?
r199790.n: Tell me what the Sculptor's disciples crave

t: Did you feel something? Is someone watching you? That's right, Sculptor watches the fights. You were right to be suspicious. The ultimate goal is not a victory or conquer. The Sculptor seeks knowledge. It's still too early for you to know it all. Don't get upset, though. I can offer you Sculptor's gifts that will come in handy.
r199791.n: Tell me what's going on in the Tower of Order

t: What do you call this ridiculous discipline that arranges and explains the chaotic behavior of living beings? Right, that would be sociological experiment. We watch you fight, and we can control the course of the battle. I can't tell you whether we're reaching a conclusion, but the process is amusing. I'm offering you the latest gifts of the Sculptor as a reward.
r199792.n: Tell me what the Sculptor wants to know

t: Oh well, it's time for you to learn the truth. Did you know that our Creator had conceived us as destructors? He wanted us to destroy the world that was his prison. Are we destined to put an end to Sarnaut? How bad is our inclination toward self-destruction? That's what the Sculptor tried to figure out. Oh, so you care about the result, don't you? The Sculptor said we were Chaotic beings, and we didn't have to follow the path we'd been programmed for. Everything we do is our choice. We either destroy the world or not. Well, it's kind of encouraging. Your help will be rewarded with the most interesting Sculptor's gifts.

r199873.n: Sure, I'll give you access! But other Portal Keepers are unaware of…

t: Hm... I guess, some Astral perturbance broke the adjustment of the portal. No big deal, I'm going to make some changes, and you'll be able to teleport to Kingdom of Elements again.
r199876.n: Portal to the Kingdom of Elements

t:
What can I say?

I don't mind the League, and I've grown to like Novograd.

But my House.... Antoinette and her daughters are in charge. They've got their own ideas. You know, this and that. Bring back the vampires, sign truce with the Empire. This may be rational. The League and Empire made a pact on Dane and defeated the architects. Could they achieve it on their own?

We're being threatened again. The darkness, the new demons. They will crush us if we're apart. We stand a chance if we're united.
r199877.n: What can you say about the League? What's House de Delice's attitude?

t:
Oh, come on. Why not? The portal is set up. Everything else is automated.

I can leave a holographic image of me to avoid questions and rush to the Ball.
r199878.n: Hello! I believe you can't just drop everything and visit the Great Ball?

t:
Aho, warrior.  is a frequent guest at our arenas! Maybe, you want to prove that you are the best, zoor?

If it so, the Battlegrounds are waiting for you. Fight with honor - or bite the dust, eysh!

I'm looking in my divination sphere, and I'm seeing you exploring all of our beautiful Novograd. You will meet an important Elf and a cheerful Gibberling. They will offer very significant jobs...
Now you're clashing with the rebels in northern Lightwood. You will learn many new things. But above all else, I see you embarking on a perilous mission into a fortress captured by the enemy.
Be careful!
r200028.n: Ask for a prediction for level 6

t:
I didn't think there would be anyone courageous enough to come here after my death. My soul has been captured by Tep's and become a prisoner of this temple forever. But then again, I suppose it's better to be a fleshless ghost than a living corpse.
We were ambushed as soon as we entered the temple. My people fought bravely but we were outnumbered.
This new evil is merciless and the undead multiply by the day. Their master is a Great Mage to the Zem people. If he is not stopped, this entire allod will turn into one massive graveyard and that would be just the start of this blight. I cannot stop Tep but I believe in you, your strength, intelligence, and courage. Finish what I started and save our world!
Goodbye! Remember me!
r200111.n: I didn't think there would be anyone courageous enough to come here…

t:
Give me your hand...
Look, can you see this line? There is a castle looming over a bleak and joyless village. The mysteries that are hidden deep within Darkwater you will discover.
These lines cross - Izbor Yavorsky, the head of the League Defenders, will give you a task himself. A druid and a priest are in dire need of aid.
A mournful wail of an unfortunate soul that is trapped by a force that is powerful and ugly. I fear that this force is going to be looking for you!
r200164.n: Give me your hand... Look, can you see this line? There is a castle…

t:
I didn't expect to see you so soon, but it's good that you've come. I saw you in my dream last night...
You went to go see our ambassador Klavdius Trojanov, he had a very important task for you. He sent you into a dark place and there were terrible enemies around every corner! Then I woke up in a cold sweat.
Do not go to the dark place alone!
r200168.n: Ask for a prediction for level 26

t:
How about you join me for a cup of tea? When you've finished, please give me your cup. Time for reading tea leaves.
Oh, look! Clearly, the leaves show the long and winding road - you will soon take a trip to Eljune to take care of many important matters!
A coin... Careful with Klavdius Trojanov's quest!
There's a shield and a mace... you will be helping Mikhail Selyaninov!
Drink some more. Now there's a tree - the gentle forestfolk will puzzle you with their dilemmas and you will uncover a great secret.
A storm cloud now! A terrible darkness is corrupting the Site of Power.
Drink. The Church of Light is in need of help. You must help them!
The last leaf remains... A monk robe means Zosim Nikulin will need you.
Hurry, dear... to Eljune!
r200169.n: Ask for a prediction for level 27

t:
We'll use the cards today. Do you see this? Two of Diamonds - for great struggle. I believe that Coba Plateau is in need of a hero! A grand problem awaits those, who...
Demon Hunters and Historians are in need for aid! In return they will help you.
r200170.n: Ask for a prediction for level 31

t:
Look me in the eye, dear, and try not to blink.
Judging by the expression of your eyes, you already know what lies in store for you. And yes, you are right.
I have seen a dragon! There will be a Great Dragon. Go see Izbor Yavorsky again before you leave. Although, perhaps he wouldn't know about the dragon himself...
r200174.n: Ask for a prediction for level 37

t:
I don't need the cards this time to tell you what you should do. Go see Aidenus immediately.
I've recently had some very bad premonitions... evil is hovering all around us. I'm sure that Aidenus is aware of it and has a new task to give to you.
The Great Mage will send you to a place unknown, but do trust him. Trust in those who have already fought the evil, the veterans of the Great Astral Campaign!
r200179.n: I don't need the cards this time to tell you what you should do. Go…

t:
Perfect timing! Yesterday I had a prophetic dream!
I saw owls, thousands of owls - it's an omen! An omen of something massive! They were heading to Novograd and each of them had a letter in their beak. Inside the letters were weird stones.
Check your mailbox right away. Important news will lead you to the new lands, new adventures, and new secrets.
r200182.n: Perfect timing! Yesterday I had a prophetic dream! I saw owls,…

t:
This is so sad! This mysterious Director who encourages everyone to find the Revelation is drawing more and more attention! People are talking about the secrets of the past, and no one cares about the future anymore! I tried glancing into the future.
Do you know what it holds? Darkness! Impenetrable darkness! I saw nothing!
Director serves his tricks, that's for sure. Maybe I should find this Revelation myself to dispel the darkness!
r200184.n: Ask for a prediction for level 45

t:
After the God of Darkness ran away, I recovered my ability to see through the veil of time!
Your future is tough and tricky. I see a coffin! This is a bad omen.Your eyes are empty and your heart is frozen. I see the endless sky reflected in the endless ocean. The sky and the sea are divided with lies and surrounded with deceit spoken by a madman trying to conquer the whole world...
There's a long road, to the stone house and many battles that would change the world forever. That's your destiny!
r200185.n: After the God of Darkness ran away, I recovered my ability to see…

t:
Show me your palm, darling.

You have a long road ahead of you, through the thicket of the forest, through ice and heat... I can see an awful disease in those far lands, the disease that you will have to fight. A mighty ship in the swirling Astral, two girls, ginger-haired and raven-haired, one laughing, one sobbing. Both are full of pride, but the pride won't do them good. I can see you walking hand in hand with one, fighting the other one, but they both will help you defeat the disaster, however unwilling they will seem to be...

I can see you talking to the ancient Gods, born before the Light, willing to save the world and your own soul from the disaster that is to come! I can also see that their time has gone, and young Gods will arrive, with burning hearts and glowing eyes... These Gods will shape the future and the fate of the world.

This is all I know, and there's nothing else. Go. May your road be straight.
r200186.n: Show me your palm, darling. You have a long road ahead of you, through…

t:
Ah, I don't even need to hold your hand or read tea leaves! I can see everything only by looking at your face.

Soon a madman will ask you for help, and you won't be able to refuse. A new road, long and winding, is waiting for you.

I can see you walking across the land that once used to be thriving. But now there where once was forest, only black stumps are left. I can see plumes of smoke above white-stone fortresses. Fire and death, as far as the eye can see - the wings of war are unfolded above that allod. And you are at the forefront, as always. But don't you lose courage - an army of allies is right behind you!

And your enemy... No. No! It can't be! Again that horror, that blue oblivion with no life or soul! Ah, I can sense a power that's above gods and stronger than the Light... The time itself abides it. And I can't see what lies at the end of the road.

Please, be careful in your ventures. A single wrong move can ruin the whole world!
r200190.n: Ah, I don't even need to hold your hand or read tea leaves! I can see…

t:
Greetings, my friend.

My prediction is really simple this time. Skulnar the Fierce will contact you. I can't tell you the reason.

But there's one thing I do know. You and I will meet again.

I'm leaving Novograd now. I'm going to the Holy Land. I had a bad dream, and my cards have been silent. So I'm thinking about getting a new deck from the Free Traders.

You should find Skulnar the Fierce. As far as I know, he's on Coldberg now.
r200193.n: Greetings, my friend. My prediction is really simple this time.…

t:
I had a dream, and in that dream there was some place forgotten by everyone...

And strange words came to mind... Here, listen.

I see it so clearly:

The tree is dying,

The ancient enemy has been awakened,

There is no rest for the dead!

Deadly Frost will come,

And countless enemies

Whose skin is white.

I see it through time.

Blood ties get stronger:

Pilgrim's children

Will take ragged weaving

And tie it into a whole.

What does it mean? I don’t know... But apparently there's a long road ahead of you... And there really is no rest for the dead! Anyway, the new ruler is a troubling one...
Great, now we can rest easy!
r200204.n: Yes! All ghosts have been found!

t: I knew I could count on you! In addition to saving the world, you will also get decent rewards that will help you in your own time! Now go through the portal. You'll receive further instructions when you get there.

We're going to the future. When we get there, I'll help you disguise yourself. Your task is to help me slow down the heroes that are particularly active in that time.

But they really are heroes, not villains. They were just... deceived. So they have to be stopped before they do irreparable damage.

So, do you know anything about the pioneers? Yes, they wear red ties and dream of building a bright Imperial future. It doesn't matter if you are the League or the Empire - you'll have to spend some time as a pioneer!

In short, I'm from the future! Don't look so surprised. Time travel is not fantasy, but reality!

The thing is, you are going to have certain problems in the future, and I'm here to fix everything. But I need your help!

For starters, we'll have to travel to the future ourselves and stop a certain someone from making an irredeemable mistake. Listen to me carefully and follow my instructions, and everything will be alright.
r200824.n: What did you want to talk about?

t: Then go to the desert and do your thing - and if you get hot, grab a bottle and have a drink. Once you're done, come back. The tasks you have to give heroes sometimes... Amazing.

Firstly, and simply: drink water. Drink a bottle - and the heat will recede!

Secondly, you should rest in shelters where jinns are. They are kind, and their magic protects them from the heat.

Thirdly, take a swim. The water - inside or outside - combats the heat well.

Finally, stay in settlements. In camps and cities, the heat is not an issue.

It's all very simple. Got it?
r200826.n: What do you need to do to avoid dying from the heat?

t: Because the heroes of the present have all been deceived, and I'm unable to reverse it. But it's not too late for you!
r200827.n: Why are you recruiting heroes from the past?

t: To stop your predecessors from destroying our world... But neither me nor my recruits can do it directly. So good old sabotage and false identities come into play... You'll understand when you get your tasks. Jump into the portal, we'll talk on the other side.
r200828.n: What do you need help with?

t:
My crowning accomplishment! Cutting the fabric of space-time in a way that creates neat little holes is a difficult task, considering the number of ruptures you and the likes of you have left behind. I patched up our poor world a little...

This rift leads to Suslanger in the future. Where I need help.
r200829.n: What kind of portals are these?

t:
In any story, there is a key moment when the future becomes set in stone. Alas, the choices we made and will make, our decisions, actions and inaction - all that shapes the future that leads to the inevitable outcome.

I need heroes that have yet to make certain decisions. Those who completed the journey to Sogot, learned the prophecies about the doom of the world, and made preparations to follow the Infinity - they are not the people I need.

I do not appear in their space-time frame.

Listen carefully.

During the Storm, the heroes we are opposing will not be able to resist their greed - they will go after the Ifrits' treasures.

The jinns are unhappy about it, so they will do everything they can to stop them. Alas, their power is not infinite.

So we... help each other. During the Storm, Ifrits will grant you special powers - you will turn into a mirage and will be able to strengthen their servants.

Ifrits will only be appeased if the servant you empowered joins a fight and dies - that's how the energy you transferred to it will return to the Ifrits.

You will get this kind of task daily.
r200831.n: Tell me about the Storm and my part in it.

t: You see, in this future the League and the Empire agreed on a truce and started working together, although I understand if you find that hard to believe. People from the League also started joining the pioneers. So anyone can become a pioneer, and no one will suspect them. It's a perfect disguise for us!

To save the world - isn't it a noble cause?

Fine, I know you, heroes. You'll be rewarded, of course. You will become stronger, more experienced, wealthier. You will lead your guild to glory... Suslanger is a prosperous place - it's where Nezeb hid his treasures. And they can become yours! So, ready to go after the treasures?

I just need to distract the heroes from the future for a while to slow them down.

Your mission is to complete my tasks. Preferably every day, but we'll see. I'll welcome any help. Call your friends if you like.

Remember - you'll be just a pioneer to everyone around you. A inconspicuous pioneer, one among many. Even the local monsters will pay no mind to you.

It will help you act covertly. Endow the Ifrits' servants with power, collect Ambrosia. With time, I might give you other tasks.

In the future, Suslanger will be selected for one very interesting scientific experiment. It would be an attempt to leave this place. But it will have certain consequences that we'd really like to avoid.

The only thing you need to know now is that a strange energy came through the Gates that were constructed there. It awakened the jinns who had been dormant for a very long time. This energy has a physical form - the Ambrosia. And it's the Ambrosia and the fire jinns, Ifrits, that we'll be dealing with.
Oh, a new recruit! I could always use an extra pair of hands...
r200836.n: Oh, a new recruit! I could always use an extra pair of hands...

t: In the name of the Light, I am now marking you with sacred oil... As this oil is pouring the mercy of the Light is covering you forever and ever!

This ritual will teach you to be a bearer of true power - that of love, mercy, and faith. May you be a mirror of all that is good in this world! May the word of Tensess be with you! May the Light embrace you! And now... you may go!
May the great Tensess be with you!
r200869.n: May the great Tensess be with you!

t:
Everybody has sinned. Even Tensess says in his Testament, that "there is no single creature in the world who never violated any virtues. May this not become an obstacle on the way to the enlightenment! Everyone can abandon the old sins and let the Light into their souls by saying: Nay to Evil, I Praise the Light!"
Here you are, you have come and said the words to receive the blessing of the Light. May those who was harmed by you, forgive you, as the Light has long done!
Go in peace now.

Not the trainer, the trainers! You need to find the Raw Family, to be precise. They're some especially jovial Gibberlings that reside in the Gibberling District. They know all there is to know about leatherworking.

Valentina de Ardeur is a famous seamstress. She makes the most beautiful ball gowns you've ever seen! She can teach you everything you need to know about tailoring. Look for her in the Elven District.

The Novograd Construction Council manages all of the capital's affairs. At the moment their main focus is completing the construction of Novograd, as you might have guessed. They also attend to the needs of the surrounding area of Lightwood. I urge you to visit them in the Trade District and volunteer your services.
r201065.n: The Novograd Construction Council manages all of the capital's…

t: The Gibberlings have recently made a new home in the colder reaches of Kania. Siveria and Frozen Frontier, to be exact. I hear they're settling down there until they can find their ancient homeland of Isa. Their leader is named Froddy the Fidget, and he's in Frozen Frontier right now. However, his ambassadors can be found in the Gibberling District.

The League Defenders are the best soldiers in the League. They have proven their worth in battle against demons. It is hard to earn their trust - where can you find demons these days?! Only in deep Astral. If you manage that, go to Aidenus' Tower. You will find two knights there: Sergey Orlovsky and Dmitry Devishev. There is also Sofia Kanianskaya. They will offer you valuable goods from their arsenal.

Not so long ago, the Elves were ruled by the House de Desirae. And even now this House has strong ties to the League. It is their representatives, Gregoire and Jules, who are in charge of the elven rewards. They can be found in the Elven Quarter, and the main office of their House is now located on Tenebra.
r201076.n: Not so long ago, the Elves were ruled by the House de Desirae. And…

t: Squabble and Carnage the Roughnecks, two Orc mercenaries who can be found on Coldberg. On behalf of Sigurd the Swindler, we are happy to equip those who have won the trust of the Free Traders.
r201085.n: Ask about the Free Traders' quartermasters

t: The Detective Bureau's latest data suggests that the Historians can be found on the remote island of Avilon. If you get there, find Arnaud de Desirae and Firk the Roughneck. The great historian Zayan instructed them to deal with equipment for those who would earn the trust of the Historians.

It's not easy to find the Demon Hunters! They never stay long in one place. But we know from intelligence reports that a small expedition stopped on a recently discovered archipelago called the Dragon Ring. And if you want to earn the trust of the Hunters and get their equipment, find Rustle the Forester, Sofia Lozhkina, and Vasily Gurov in their camp.
r201089.n: Ask about the Demon Hunters' quartermasters

t: The Overlords are a faction of the Wormfaces that live in the Gipat Caverns. Very little is known about them, but now, thanks to the Director, we will be able to communicate with them. It is said that they generously reward anyone who helps them. You will need to contact the master of rewards Lord Krosus and his assistants.

Time travel? A miracle? No, it's reality. It is quite possible these days - and some mysterious quartermasters have appeared, ready to reward other time travelers! You can find them on one of the Gipat shards known as the Crossroads!
r201097.n: Time travel? A miracle? No, it's reality. It is quite possible these…

t: So you've reached a high level of development? It's time to get a new kind of equipment - regular quartermasters can't help you anymore. You can get it from Naia Windina who can be found in the Astral Academy next to the forge. It's not the best possible equipment, but it should do for a start. Naia will give you a full set of items, and you can change their stats using special insignias.
r201103.n: So you've reached a high level of development? It's time to get a new…

t:
The Servants of the Light are beautiful maidens that have devoted their entire lives to the Light! They can be dashing Elven women or noble Kanian girls.
They're everywhere and they're always ready to help travelers by selling drops of mirra. You can visit the Church of Light in the Main Square to find one of these wonderful Servants.
r201105.n: Ask about the Servants of the Light

t: You're looking for Felix de Grandeur in the Elven District. Word on the street is that Aidenus wants to nominate him to be a Great Mage. He's very skilled! I'm sure he can teach you anything you want to know.

Yaroslav Radiev is who you seek. He's an experienced priest of the Church of Light. His whole life is dedicated to spreading the teachings of Tensess and he will be pleased to speak with you. You can find him in the church in the Main Square!
r201111.n: Yaroslav Radiev is who you seek. He's an experienced priest of the…

t: They say meeting Victor Voronov brings good luck. He saved no less than several dozen Gibberling children during an octulhu's attack on some settlers' ship. He blinded that Astral beast using the light of his faith! You'll find him near the Main Square of Novograd.
r201115.n: They say meeting Victor Voronov brings good luck. He saved no less…

t: The ruling Elven House de Desirae is known for studying dark magic. The teacher of this magic, Rene de Desirae, hails from that house. If you're interested in seeing him, you can find him in the Elven District.
r201121.n: The ruling Elven House de Desirae is known for studying dark magic.…

t: You've come to the right place if you want to learn more battle techniques. Novograd is filled with experienced teachers! All of them are under orders right now to train anyone who wants to learn. In times like these the League needs everyone to be at their best!
r201130.n: You've come to the right place if you want to learn more battle…

t: Pierre de Desirae represents the interests of the Elves here in Novograd. He speaks for Marguerite de Desirae, the head of the ruling House de Desirae, but she lives on the allod of Tenebra. I hear she has her hands quite full with some important matters, for she hasn't visited Novograd herself in a long time.
Marianne de Ardeur was the first of her people to accept Tensess into her heart. Voisvet Belov used to lead the Church of Light, but after his disappearance this great honor was passed on to her.

Not so long ago, a mysterious Alice appeared in our world. She claims to have traveled through time, so she knows what happened in the past and will happen in the future. Perhaps she's lying, but who knows? It's hard to know what to believe these days. But if you are wondering what might happen to you in the future if you go on newly unlocked raid adventures, then you need to talk to her.
r201144.n: Not so long ago, a mysterious Alice appeared in our world. She claims…

t: The mysterious Alice that suddenly appeared in our world is of great interest to the City Council. Alas, our agents have been unable to locate her. But ordinary heroes like you can easily meet her. If you would like an opportunity to look into the future and see what is happening there, you should reach out to her. Of course, it's quite a gamble, but perhaps you will be able to learn more than the Detective Bureau has.
r201145.n: Ask about Alice, the time traveler

t:
We have many important citizens right here in Novograd. There are the ambassadors of the Elves and the Gibberlings, as well as the leaders of the Church of Light and the League Defenders.
You can even meet Aidenus himself. Aidenus is the leader of the League, you know. We all owe our lives to his guidance.
r201148.n: We have many important citizens right here in Novograd. There are the…

t:
Here's the scoop - there's a bank that just opened in the city.

All citizens are allowed to store things there so we don't have to lug everything around with us. However, it's still partially under construction.

I heard that Aidenus isn't pleased about this, so now the Construction Council is running around like a bunch of chickens with their heads cut off trying to get it all done by the deadline. I sure hope they make it!
r201153.n: Here's the scoop - there's a bank that just opened in the city. All…

t: In addition to fighting the League and other enemies in the open world, the brave defenders of the Empire can take part in battles at special training grounds. Here, death means nothing, because everyone is resurrected by the Great Mages. And those who win can receive special rewards. You can learn more from the quartermasters of the respective skirmishes. You can find them in the main square not far from the southern gates. Boyko Sokolov will tell you about the Guild Dominion, Gaal-Bran the Gloomy - about rating combats, and the Roughneck Family - about random skirmishes. In addition, you can also find merchants selling rare goods there, like trophies from the battlefields.

We can't wage wars all the time! Sometimes we need more peaceful activities like swimming on a summer night or jumping over a fire! And there is a more fashionable activity named goblinball. It's an ancient Orc sport, and now anyone can participate. Yes, yes, the League also participates - with Aidenus's approval, they say. There are also championships for those talented enough. You can discuss all that with the sisters Rogneda Whistlie and Barbell the Referie who can be found on the main square near the southern gates.
r201163.n: We can't wage wars all the time! Sometimes we need more peaceful…

t: A beautiful girlhandsome guy caught your eye? Then what's the problem? Find yourselves a big haystack and have a go at it! But if it's serious, then a priest can marry you. We have one in Novograd, her name is Helena Bugakova. Feel free to ask her. And you won't be committing a sin.

Do you think you might make a decent herald? Your skills will not go to waste, because the Free Traders, with Aidenus's permission, have launched a special program to get new heroes to participate in adventures in our world. And you can help them. You can find out the details from the Unselfish Family, representatives of the Tycoons, and you can find them in the bank on the main square of Novograd.
r201175.n: Do you think you might make a decent herald? Your skills will not go…

t: Our world is full of various mounts - both living and mechanical. Progress does not stand still! There is always something new coming out. Ivan Ovsov, an experienced horse breeder, can tell you all about them. He is well versed in technology - he can tell you about assault shells, for example. You can find him in Lightwood, in front of the main gates to Novograd.

Our world holds many secrets. Lovewise Catfish, once a member of the Historians, was invited by Aidenus to come to Novograd and collect information about these secrets.
He searches for knowledge about recent events as well as those from many, many years ago. If you happen to find some important piece of information, head to Aidenus' Tower and tell Lovewise right away.
r201184.n: Our world holds many secrets. Lovewise Catfish, once a member of the…

t: Sarnaut is full of new and ancient secrets, but unfortunately we only know a few of them! That's why the League has been working hard to solve as many mysteries as possible. I can tell you everything I know about the knowledge that's already available to the public.
r201187.n: Sarnaut is full of new and ancient secrets, but unfortunately we only…
